title: Cutting AI Datacenter Energy with Reinforcement Learning: Measured Power Control of LLM Training from One GPU to the Fleet
abstract: arXiv:2608.11226v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement-learning post-training dominates modern language-model development, yet its power behavior on GPU hardware has not been characterized, and datacenters manage GPU power with workload-blind mechanisms, static caps and reactive throttling, that slow hardware indiscriminately. We instrument GRPO training with half-second power telemetry at 7B, 14B, and 72B scales on one to four A100s (380,000+ samples), and train a PPO meta-controller that adapts the workload's own generation parameters to measured power. Against the full 500-step 7B trace, the controller cuts power-limit violations by 89.8% while increasing token output by 18.1% and energy efficiency by 26.2% (tokens per MWh). Deployed live at 72B, the same controller family yields replicated null results, diagnosed as the group-size actuator losing authority under model sharding. An actuator-authority sweep shows the same parameters applied as generation concurrency retain 17

translated_title: 利用强化学习削减AI数据中心能耗：从单GPU到整个集群的LLM训练实测功率控制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11226v1 公告类型：新 摘要：强化学习后训练主导了现代语言模型的发展，但其在GPU硬件上的功耗行为尚未被表征，且数据中心使用对工作负载无感知的机制（静态上限和反应式限流）管理GPU功率，这会不加区分地降低硬件速度。我们在7B、14B和72B规模下，使用半秒级功率遥测对GRPO训练进行了仪器化测量（覆盖1到4个A100 GPU，超过38万个样本），并训练了一个PPO元控制器，该控制器根据实测功率自适应调整工作负载自身的生成参数。针对完整的500步7B轨迹，该控制器将功率限制违规减少了89.8%，同时将令牌输出提高了18.1%，能源效率（每兆瓦时令牌数）提高了26.2%。在72B规模下实时部署时，同一控制器系列产生了可复制的无效结果，经诊断归因于模型分片下群组大小执行器失去权威性。执行器权威性扫描表明，相同的参数在作为生成并发应用时，保留了17（原文截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种基于强化学习的元控制器，通过自适应调整LLM训练生成参数来动态控制GPU功耗，在7B规模下显著减少功率违规并提升能效，但在72B规模下因模型分片导致执行器失效。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a reinforcement-learning-based meta-controller that adaptively adjusts LLM training generation parameters to control GPU power, significantly reducing power violations and improving energy efficiency at 7B scale, but failing at 72B scale due to actuator authority loss under model sharding.
